node_definition.done_when: in reckon/crew/recovery.py dispatch_repair_for_run, when the reviewed run still has its live pointer, is not promoted, and its worker process has exited, the composed repair (its blocking findings, done_when and negative control) is delivered as advice to a crew resume of the reviewed run itself (the same entry point reckon crew resume uses, found in reckon/crew/resumption.py or its caller), and no new repair node is dispatched; the repair record is written with status resumed and the round id, and a second sweep for the same round resumes nothing. A reviewed run whose worker is still live, or whose pointer is gone or promoted, keeps today's behaviour. A new tests/test_the_reflex_resumes_an_unpromoted_run.py, with the resume entry point and dispatch both stubbed, covers an unpromoted exited run with one blocking finding (resumed once with advice naming the finding id, dispatch never called), the same round swept twice (one resume), and a promoted run (no resume, existing refusal). Only the named test files are run, with no call reaching SLURM and no real worker launched, each log ending with an EXIT= line; the coordinator runs the wider population at merge. Before status complete, delete every directory you created under /tmp, print what you delete, and list it in artifacts.
